descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le filtre d'événements (EF) fait partie du système ATLAS Trigger and Data Acquisition (TDAQ) et se compose d'une ferme de traitement asynchrone multithreadée de serveurs de marchandises (CPUs avec ou sans accélérateurs) exécutant un sous-ensemble d'algorithmes de reconstruction hors ligne ainsi que la sélection d'événements pilotés par menu. Les conditions de luminosité élevées attendues au cours des opérations de phase II présentent des défis importants pour les algorithmes de reconstruction d'objets et d'événements prévus pour l'EF, en particulier pour la reconstruction des voies. La définition récente de la ferme EF en tant qu'architecture hétérogène combinant les CPU et les GPU ouvre de nouvelles possibilités de déploiement de modèles d'apprentissage automatique dans le cadre du processus de suivi EF. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe du CERN ATLAS et contribuerez à la recherche sur l'application des techniques ML pour la reconstruction des voies au HL-LHC, dans le but d'identifier et d'explorer les approches les plus prometteuses pour le déploiement dans le suivi de l'EF ATLAS. Ce poste fait partie du programme de déclenchement de la prochaine génération. Vos responsabilités :
• Mener des recherches sur l'apprentissage machine (ML) et les approches basées sur l'IA pour la reconstruction des voies, en mettant l'accent sur l'applicabilité et la performance de ces méthodes dans l'environnement de mise en place élevée du HL-LHC.
• Étudier et comparer les nouveaux algorithmes de suivi basés sur la LM et leur intégration dans le flux de travail de suivi de l'EF basé sur l'ACTS.
• Contribuer à l'étude des performances physiques et des performances informatiques des différentes configurations étudiées.
• Ce rôle comprend les responsabilités de supervision de l'équipe. Votre profil:
• Compréhension des défis de suivi dans les environnements à haute densité de piste, comme au LHC à haute luminosité.
• Expérience dans le développement et l'application de méthodes d'apprentissage automatique ou de méthodes d'apprentissage profond dans un contexte de physique ou de calcul scientifique.
• Expérience pratique dans le développement de logiciels de reconstruction hors ligne et/ou en ligne.
• Capacité de diriger des équipes et de définir des orientations. Compétences :
• Apprentissage automatique et cadres d'apprentissage profond.
• Expérience du déploiement de l'inférence ML.
• Connaissance de la formation, de l'évaluation et de l'optimisation des modèles ML, y compris le réglage hyperparamétrique et l'étalonnage des performances.
• Langages de programmation: C++ et Python, y compris les flux de développement de logiciels (Git, Jira).
• L'expérience des cadres logiciels scientifiques à grande échelle (p. ex. ACTS, Athena) est considérée comme un atout.
• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français. Critères d'éligibilité:
• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en Physique des particules / CS (ou un domaine connexe) et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;

Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place Date de début prévue : 01 octobre 2026 Cette position implique:

jobs.description:
Introduction:
 As Engineer in Charge of the CERN Proton Synchrotron ( PS ), you will contribute to the safe, efficient and performance-driven operation of the accelerator, combining operational follow up, technical problem solving, performance analysis and software development.
 You will play an active role in improving PS operation through data driven analysis, high level control applications and automation-oriented developments, with the aim of making operation more robust, reproducible and efficient.
 Functions:

• Take an active role in the safe, efficient and performance-driven operation of the PS and its associated beam lines during commissioning, regular operation, and machine development studies.

• Analyse PS operational issues, assess their impact on beam performance and availability, and collaborate with equipment experts, controls specialists and operations teams to define and implement effective solutions.

• Drive automation-oriented developments for PS operation by identifying operational processes that can be made more robust, reproducible and efficient, and translating them into tools, procedures and applications that increase the autonomy of the accelerator.

• Drive the performance optimisation of the PS beams for the LHC and the fixed target facilities, combining accelerator studies, operational data analysis and close collaboration with operations crews, machine experts and physics users.

• Prepare, validate and improve operational settings, procedures and diagnostics required for reliable and reproducible PS operation.

• Engage in cross-accelerator activities to share operational experience, promote synergies and develop common approaches for performance optimisation, software tools and automation, ensuring that best practices are transferred across CERN’s accelerator complex.

• Develop, maintain and improve software tools, high level control applications and data analysis workflows supporting performance optimisation and operational decision making.

• Propose, conduct and support machine development studies aimed at improving beam performance, operational efficiency and the understanding of PS limitations.

• Share the operational status, performance analyses and improvement activities through clear updates, presentations and reports.

• Identify and provide operational input for consolidation and upgrade activities, and future studies.

• Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Physics, Engineering or a related field.
 Experience:

• Experience with accelerator operation or strong interest in developing a solid understanding of PS operation, accelerator systems and beam dynamics.

• Experience in performance analysis, optimisation and the development or improvement of operational tools, with the motivation to become a key technical reference for PS operation.

• Ability to understand and improve complex technical systems involving hardware, controls, software, operational constraints and beam performance aspects.

• Proficiency in software development with Python, combined with experience in data analysis, diagnostics, performance monitoring or operational decision support.

• Strong problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes and define pragmatic solutions in a complex operational environment.

• Motivation and ability to drive automation, high level control applications and data driven methods to make accelerator operation more robust, reproducible and efficient.

• Ability to work autonomously, take initiative and collaborate effectively with operations crews, equipment experts, controls specialists and other accelerator teams.

• Ability to communicate technical results clearly through status updates, reports and presentations.

• Knowledge of optimisation methods, feedback control or control algorithms would be an asset, in particular for applications to beam performance, automation or operational decision support.

• Experience with operation, commissioning, performance optimisation or troubleshooting of complex scientific, technical or industrial facilities would be an advantage.

• Knowledge of Java, accelerator controls, high level control applications or operational software would be an asset.
 Technical competencies:

• Analysis and optimisation of accelerator performance.

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.

• Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.

• Operation of accelerators.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Solving Problems: producing workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily absorbing new techniques and working practices; proposing new or improved ways of working.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
 Language skills:

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 19.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Employment Conditions:
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Hybrid
 This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: BE-OP-PS-2026-128-LD
 Field of work: Applied Physics
 Benchmark Job Title: Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

Funzioni:

• Comunicare efficacemente: esprimere opinioni, idee e suggerimenti con convinzione e in modo logico/strutturato; mantenere al punto.

Introduction:
As Engineer in Charge of the CERN Proton Synchrotron ( PS ), you will contribute to the safe, efficient and performance-driven operation of the accelerator, combining operational follow up, technical problem solving, performance analysis and software development.
You will play an active role in improving PS operation through data driven analysis, high level control applications and automation-oriented developments, with the aim of making operation more robust, reproducible and efficient.
Functions:

• Take an active role in the safe, efficient and performance-driven operation of the PS and its associated beam lines during commissioning, regular operation, and machine development studies.

• Analyse PS operational issues, assess their impact on beam performance and availability, and collaborate with equipment experts, controls specialists and operations teams to define and implement effective solutions.

• Drive automation-oriented developments for PS operation by identifying operational processes that can be made more robust, reproducible and efficient, and translating them into tools, procedures and applications that increase the autonomy of the accelerator.

• Drive the performance optimisation of the PS beams for the LHC and the fixed target facilities, combining accelerator studies, operational data analysis and close collaboration with operations crews, machine experts and physics users.

• Prepare, validate and improve operational settings, procedures and diagnostics required for reliable and reproducible PS operation.

• Engage in cross-accelerator activities to share operational experience, promote synergies and develop common approaches for performance optimisation, software tools and automation, ensuring that best practices are transferred across CERN’s accelerator complex.

• Develop, maintain and improve software tools, high level control applications and data analysis workflows supporting performance optimisation and operational decision making.

• Propose, conduct and support machine development studies aimed at improving beam performance, operational efficiency and the understanding of PS limitations.

• Share the operational status, performance analyses and improvement activities through clear updates, presentations and reports.

• Identify and provide operational input for consolidation and upgrade activities, and future studies.

• Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Physics, Engineering or a related field.
Experience:

• Experience with accelerator operation or strong interest in developing a solid understanding of PS operation, accelerator systems and beam dynamics.

• Experience in performance analysis, optimisation and the development or improvement of operational tools, with the motivation to become a key technical reference for PS operation.

• Ability to understand and improve complex technical systems involving hardware, controls, software, operational constraints and beam performance aspects.

• Proficiency in software development with Python, combined with experience in data analysis, diagnostics, performance monitoring or operational decision support.

• Strong problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes and define pragmatic solutions in a complex operational environment.

• Motivation and ability to drive automation, high level control applications and data driven methods to make accelerator operation more robust, reproducible and efficient.

• Ability to work autonomously, take initiative and collaborate effectively with operations crews, equipment experts, controls specialists and other accelerator teams.

• Ability to communicate technical results clearly through status updates, reports and presentations.

• Knowledge of optimisation methods, feedback control or control algorithms would be an asset, in particular for applications to beam performance, automation or operational decision support.

• Experience with operation, commissioning, performance optimisation or troubleshooting of complex scientific, technical or industrial facilities would be an advantage.

• Knowledge of Java, accelerator controls, high level control applications or operational software would be an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Analysis and optimisation of accelerator performance.

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.

• Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.

• Operation of accelerators.
Behavioural competencies:

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Préparer, valider et améliorer les paramètres opérationnels, les procédures et les diagnostics nécessaires pour un fonctionnement PS fiable et reproductible.
• S'engager dans des activités inter-accélérateurs pour partager l'expérience opérationnelle, promouvoir les synergies et développer des approches communes pour l'optimisation des performances, les outils logiciels et l'automatisation, en veillant à ce que les meilleures pratiques soient transférées à travers le complexe d'accélérateur du CERN.
• Développer, maintenir et améliorer les outils logiciels, les applications de contrôle de haut niveau et les flux de travail d'analyse de données qui soutiennent l'optimisation des performances et la prise de décisions opérationnelles.
• Proposer, mener et soutenir des études de développement de machines visant à améliorer la performance du faisceau, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la compréhension des limites de PS.
• Partager l'état opérationnel, les analyses de rendement et les activités d'amélioration au moyen de mises à jour, de présentations et de rapports clairs.
• Identifier et fournir une contribution opérationnelle aux activités de consolidation et de mise à niveau, ainsi qu'aux études futures.
• Maîtrise ou doctorat ou expérience pertinente équivalente dans le domaine de la physique, du génie ou d'un domaine connexe. Expérience :
• Expérience avec le fonctionnement de l'accélérateur ou un grand intérêt pour développer une solide compréhension du fonctionnement de PS, des systèmes d'accélérateur et de la dynamique du faisceau.
• Expérience dans l'analyse des performances, l'optimisation et le développement ou l'amélioration des outils opérationnels, avec la motivation de devenir une référence technique clé pour le fonctionnement PS.
• Capacité de comprendre et d'améliorer des systèmes techniques complexes comportant du matériel, des commandes, des logiciels, des contraintes opérationnelles et des aspects de performance du faisceau.
• Compétence en développement logiciel avec Python, associée à l'expérience en analyse de données, diagnostics, suivi des performances ou support de décision opérationnelle.
• Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes, capables d'étudier les questions techniques, d'identifier les causes profondes et de définir des solutions pragmatiques dans un environnement opérationnel complexe.
• Motivation et capacité à conduire l'automatisation, les applications de contrôle de haut niveau et les méthodes de données pour rendre le fonctionnement de l'accélérateur plus robuste, reproductible et efficace.
• Capacité de travailler de façon autonome, de prendre des initiatives et de collaborer efficacement avec les équipes opérationnelles, les experts en équipement, les spécialistes des commandes et d'autres équipes d'accélérateur.
• Capacité de communiquer clairement les résultats techniques au moyen de mises à jour, de rapports et de présentations.
• La connaissance des méthodes d'optimisation, du contrôle de la rétroaction ou des algorithmes de contrôle serait un atout, en particulier pour les applications aux performances de faisceaux, à l'automatisation ou au soutien de la décision opérationnelle.
• L'expérience de l'exploitation, de la mise en service, de l'optimisation des performances ou du dépannage d'installations scientifiques, techniques ou industrielles complexes serait un avantage.
• La connaissance de Java, des commandes d'accélérateur, des applications de contrôle de haut niveau ou des logiciels opérationnels serait un atout. Compétences techniques:
• Analyse et optimisation des performances de l'accélérateur.
• Connaissance et application des outils et des procédures du cycle de vie des logiciels.
• Connaissance des techniques de programmation et des langues.
• Fonctionnement des accélérateurs. Compétences comportementales :
• Résoudre les problèmes : produire des solutions pratiques et opportunes qui répondent aux exigences.
• Démontrer la responsabilité : prendre la responsabilité de ses propres actions et décisions.
• Démontrer la souplesse : absorber facilement les nouvelles techniques et les nouvelles pratiques de travail; proposer des méthodes de travail nouvelles ou améliorées.
• Communiquer efficacement : exprimer des opinions, des idées et des suggestions avec conviction et d'une manière logique/structurée; se tenir au fait.
• Travailler en équipe : établir et maintenir des relations de travail constructives et efficaces. Compétences linguistiques :

jobs.description:
Role and composition of the PFGB
 The functions of the PFGB are laid down in Article I 2.05 of the Fund’s rules and, amongst other things, include monitoring the actuarial status of the Fund, reviewing the Annual Report & Financial Statements, approving the Statement of Investment Principles, Investment Guidelines, Risk Limit, and Strategic Asset Allocation, and approving the internal audit plan.
 The composition of the PFGB is laid down in Article I 2.06 of the Fund’s rules. The PFGB is required to have at least ten members, comprising two members appointed by the CERN Council, one appointed by the ESO Council, one ex-officio member appointed by CERN Management, two appointed by the CERN Staff Association, one appointed by the ESO Staff Association, one appointed by the CERN and ESO Pensioner Association, and two professional members specialised in pension fund matters appointed by the CERN Council. The Chief Executive Officer attends all meetings in his capacity as Secretary to the board but is not a voting member.
 The members of the PFGB are appointed for a maximum period of three years, renewable once for a further maximum consecutive period of three years.
 Description of Work
 The PFGB usually holds five meetings each year, including one joint meeting with the ATC and one with the IC, but additional meetings or conference calls may be scheduled if required. Typically, meetings last a full day and take place at CERN in Geneva, Switzerland, or exceptionally by videoconference. Professional members are expected to attend every meeting and are required to act in the best interests of the Fund and to abide by the CERN Code of Conduct and the Pension Fund Implementation Guidelines .

Candidates are required with deep and extensive experience of overseeing the assets and liabilities of large pension funds, or similar long-term institutional investors, such as endowments, foundations, and sovereign wealth funds.
 Candidates should have academic and/or professional qualifications and experience in some of the following areas:

• Corporate/pension fund governance

• Actuarial science

• Asset management

• Portfolio construction

• Financial reporting

• Risk management

• Global custody

• Auditing

• Pensions administration
 Appointments are made on an individual basis. Applicants employed by a firm may apply, but only in a personal capacity.

Fees
 A market-competitive fee will be payable to external experts appointed. Further information will be provided during the selection process.
 Applications
 Interested persons should apply with a CV (.PDF format), by clicking "I'm interested" on this link.
 Deadlines
 Applications will be accepted until 30 August 2026. Interviews for selected candidates will take place by videoconference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ruolo e composizione del PFGB Le funzioni del PFGB sono definite nell’articolo I 2.05 delle regole del Fondo e, tra l’altro, includono il monitoraggio dello stato attuariale del Fondo, la revisione della Relazione annuale & Bilancio, l’approvazione del Bilancio dei Principi di Investimento, le Linee Guida agli Investimenti, il Limite di Rischio e l’Allocation dei Beni Strategici e l’approvazione del piano di audit interno. La composizione del PFGB è prevista dall’articolo I 2.06 del regolamento del Fondo. Il PFGB è tenuto ad avere almeno dieci membri, composto da due membri nominati dal Consiglio del CERN, uno nominato dal Consiglio dell'ESO, un ex-officio nominato dalla Direzione del CERN, due nominati dall'Associazione Personale del CERN, uno nominato dall'Associazione Personale dell'ESO, uno nominato dall'Associazione Pensione del CERN e dell'ESO, e due membri professionali specializzati in materia di fondi pensione nominati dal Consiglio del CERN. L'Amministratore Delegato partecipa a tutte le riunioni in qualità di Segretario al Consiglio, ma non è membro del voto. I membri del PFGB sono nominati per un periodo massimo di tre anni, rinnovabile una volta per un ulteriore periodo massimo consecutivo di tre anni. Descrizione del lavoro Il PFGB di solito tiene cinque incontri ogni anno, tra cui un incontro congiunto con l'ATC e uno con l'IC, ma riunioni aggiuntive o conferenze possono essere programmate se necessario. Tipicamente, gli incontri durano una giornata intera e si svolgono al CERN di Ginevra, in Svizzera, o eccezionalmente tramite videoconferenza. I membri professionali sono tenuti a partecipare ad ogni riunione e sono tenuti ad agire nei migliori interessi del Fondo e ad attenersi al Codice di condotta del CERN e alle Linee guida per l'attuazione del Fondo pensionistico . I candidati sono tenuti con profonda e vasta esperienza di supervisionare le attività e le passività dei grandi fondi pensione, o simili investitori istituzionali a lungo termine, come doti, fondazioni e fondi di ricchezza sovrana. I candidati dovrebbero avere qualifiche e/o esperienze accademiche e professionali in alcune delle seguenti aree:
• Corporate/pension fund governance
• Scienze attuariali
• Gestione delle risorse
• Portfolio costruzione
• Relazione finanziaria
• Gestione del rischio
• Protezione globale
• Audizione
• Amministrazione delle pensioni Le nomine sono fatte su base individuale. I candidati impiegati da un'impresa possono applicarsi, ma solo in una capacità personale. Tasse Una quota di mercato competitivo sarà pagabile agli esperti esterni nominati. Ulteriori informazioni saranno fornite durante il processo di selezione. Applicazioni Le persone interessate dovrebbero applicarsi con un CV (formato PDF), cliccando su "Sono interessato" su questo link. Scadenza Le domande saranno accettate fino al 30 agosto 2026. Le interviste per i candidati selezionati avranno luogo per videoconferenza.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Rolle und Zusammensetzung des PFGB Die Funktionen des PFGB sind in Artikel I 2.05 der Fondsordnung festgelegt und umfassen unter anderem die Überwachung des versicherungsmathematischen Status des Fonds, die Überprüfung des Geschäftsberichts und des Jahresabschlusses, die Genehmigung der Anlagegrundsätze, der Anlagerichtlinien, der Risikogrenze und der strategischen Asset Allocation sowie die Genehmigung des internen Auditplans. Die Zusammensetzung des PFGB ist in Artikel I 2.06 der Fondsordnung festgelegt. Der PFGB muss mindestens zehn Mitglieder haben, bestehend aus zwei vom CERN-Rat ernannten Mitgliedern, einem vom ESO-Rat ernannten Mitglied, einem von Amts wegen vom CERN-Management ernannten Mitglied, zwei vom CERN-Personalverband ernannten Mitgliedern, einem vom ESO-Personalverband ernannten Mitglied, einem vom CERN und dem ESO-Rentenverband ernannten Mitgliedern und zwei vom CERN-Rat ernannten auf Pensionskassenangelegenheiten spezialisierten Berufsmitgliedern. Der Chief Executive Officer nimmt in seiner Eigenschaft als Sekretär des Boards an allen Sitzungen teil, ist aber kein stimmberechtigtes Mitglied. Die Mitglieder des PFGB werden für einen Zeitraum von maximal drei Jahren ernannt, einmalig verlängerbar für einen weiteren Zeitraum von maximal drei aufeinander folgenden Jahren. Beschreibung der Arbeit Der PFGB hält in der Regel fünf Sitzungen pro Jahr ab, darunter eine gemeinsame Sitzung mit dem ATC und eine mit dem IC, aber bei Bedarf können zusätzliche Sitzungen oder Telefonkonferenzen geplant werden. Normalerweise dauern Meetings einen ganzen Tag und finden im CERN in Genf, Schweiz, oder ausnahmsweise per Videokonferenz statt. Von professionellen Mitgliedern wird erwartet, dass sie an jeder Sitzung teilnehmen und verpflichtet sind, im besten Interesse des Fonds zu handeln und sich an den CERN-Verhaltenskodex und die Durchführungsrichtlinien für Pensionsfonds zu halten. Die Kandidaten sind mit fundierter und umfangreicher Erfahrung in der Überwachung der Vermögenswerte und Verbindlichkeiten großer Pensionsfonds oder ähnlicher langfristiger institutioneller Anleger wie Stiftungen, Stiftungen und Staatsfonds erforderlich. Die Bewerber müssen über akademische und/oder berufliche Qualifikationen und Erfahrung in einigen der folgenden Bereiche verfügen:
• Unternehmensführung/Pensionsfonds
• Versicherungsmathematische Wissenschaft
• Vermögensverwaltung
• Portfolioaufbau
• Finanzberichterstattung
• Risikomanagement
• Globale Verwahrung
• Auditierung
• Rentenverwaltung Termine werden individuell vereinbart. Bewerber, die bei einem Unternehmen beschäftigt sind, können sich bewerben, jedoch nur in persönlicher Eigenschaft. Gebühren Eine marktübliche Vergütung wird an externe Sachverständige gezahlt. Weitere Informationen werden während des Auswahlprozesses bereitgestellt. Anträge Interessierte Personen sollten sich mit einem CV (.PDF-Format) bewerben, indem sie auf diesem Link auf "Ich bin interessiert" klicken. Fristen Bewerbungen werden bis zum 30. August 2026 angenommen. Interviews für ausgewählte Kandidaten finden per Videokonferenz statt.

Rôle et composition du PFGB Les fonctions du PFGB sont définies à l'article I 2.05 des règles du Fonds et comprennent, entre autres, le suivi de l'état actuariel du Fonds, l'examen du rapport annuel et des états financiers, l'approbation de la déclaration des principes d'investissement, des lignes directrices en matière d'investissement, de la limite de risque et de la répartition stratégique des actifs, et l'approbation du plan d'audit interne. La composition du PFGB est définie à l'article I 2.06 du règlement du Fonds. Le PFGB est tenu d'avoir au moins dix membres, comprenant deux membres nommés par le Conseil du CERN, un membre nommé par le Conseil de l'ESO, un membre d'office nommé par la direction du CERN, deux membres nommés par l'Association du personnel du CERN, un membre nommé par l'Association du personnel de l'ESO, un membre nommé par le CERN et l'Association des retraités de l'ESO, et deux membres professionnels spécialisés dans les questions relatives aux fonds de pension désignés par le Conseil du CERN. Le premier dirigeant assiste à toutes les réunions en sa qualité de secrétaire du conseil, mais il n'est pas membre votant. Les membres du PFGB sont nommés pour une période maximale de trois ans, renouvelable une fois pour une nouvelle période maximale consécutive de trois ans. Devis descriptif Le CGFP tient habituellement cinq réunions chaque année, dont une avec l'ATC et une avec le CI, mais d'autres réunions ou conférences téléphoniques peuvent être prévues au besoin. Généralement, les réunions durent une journée entière et ont lieu au CERN à Genève, en Suisse, ou exceptionnellement par vidéoconférence. Les administrateurs sont tenus d' assister à toutes les réunions et d' agir dans l' intérêt supérieur de la Caisse et de respecter le Code de conduite du CERN et les directives de mise en œuvre de la Caisse des pensions . Les candidats doivent posséder une expérience approfondie et approfondie de la surveillance de l'actif et du passif de grands fonds de pension, ou d'investisseurs institutionnels à long terme similaires, tels que les fonds de dotation, les fondations et les fonds souverains. Les candidats doivent posséder des qualifications et une expérience académiques et/ou professionnelles dans certains des domaines suivants:
• Gouvernance de l'entreprise/du fonds de pension
• Sciences actuarielles
• Gestion des biens
• Construction de portefeuilles
• Rapports financiers
• Gestion des risques
• Garde mondiale
• Vérification des comptes
• Administration des pensions Les nominations sont faites sur une base individuelle. Les candidats employés par une entreprise peuvent présenter une demande, mais seulement à titre personnel. Frais Des honoraires concurrentiels seront versés aux experts externes nommés. Des renseignements supplémentaires seront fournis au cours du processus de sélection. Demandes Les personnes intéressées doivent présenter une demande avec un CV (format PDF), en cliquant sur « Je suis intéressé » sur ce lien. Délais Les candidatures seront acceptées jusqu'au 30 août 2026. Les entrevues pour les candidats sélectionnés auront lieu par vidéoconférence.

jobs.title: Sustainability Reporting & Communications Project Officer (OSI-ICS-2026-125-GRAP)

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de projet de rapports et de communications sur la durabilité (OSI-ICS-2026-125-GRAP)

jobs.description:
Do you have experience in sustainability reporting? Do you enjoy gathering and analysing information to deliver powerful communications that meet the needs of a variety of stakeholders? Do you have good project management skills and the ability to share complex data and stories in way that is engaging, inspiring and which supports culture change?
 Working in the Sustainability Office within the Organisational Support & Improvement team, the Sustainability Reporting & Communications Project Officer will work closely with a broad network of internal stakeholders, as well as external consultants, in delivering the Sustainability Reporting Project workstream.
 You will also contribute to the development of CERN's Sustainability Strategy, with dedicated actions to raise awareness CERN-wide about sustainability, for example through targeted campaigns and communications that support cultural change around sustainability.
 Through these activities, you will develop hands-on experience in sustainability strategy creation, implementation and reporting within a dynamic, high-profile, international scientific and technical environment.
 Your responsibilities

• Support the delivery of CERN's 2025-2026 Sustainability Report (to be published in late 2027), from planning through to publication, and then assist preparations for the subsequent 2027-2028 reporting cycle.

• Write and edit social and governance content to a high standard for the Report, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and alignment with relevant GRI standards.

• Ensure adherence to the project plan, timeline, and documented approvals process.

• Produce engaging content for different channels and audiences, such as web, social media, short articles, and other formats that is consistent with strategy and reporting.

• Contribute to the development of an internal CERN e-learning module on sustainability.

• Support the planning and delivery of sustainability-related campaigns and events as needed.

• Track regulatory developments and evolving reporting standards (GRI, CSRD, ESRS) relevant to CERN's ESG framework.
 More information here .
 Your profile

• Experience of drafting sustainability or ESG reports in a corporate, NGO, research institution or public sector context, or in an advisory capacity.

• Experience managing complex, multi-workstream projects against firm deadlines with documented governance.

• Experience developing and implementing communications plans and outreach activities is desirable.

• Experience with digital content management systems and sustainability microsite or web content is desirable.

• Experience in a scientific, academic or intergovernmental setting is desirable.
 Skills

• Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to produce clear, accurate, well-structured content for diverse audiences.

• Ability to work across functions, build trust, and obtain buy-in from varied stakeholders.

• French language proficiency is strongly desirable.

• Knowledge of GRI, CSRD/ESRS, or equivalent reporting frameworks and data visualisation or infographic design skills are desirable.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Sustainability, Communications (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 21.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-October-2026
 Job reference: OSI-ICS-2026-125-GRAP
 Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
 Benchmark job: 5B0110 - Business Process Support Officer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

Do you have experience in sustainability reporting? Do you enjoy gathering and analysing information to deliver powerful communications that meet the needs of a variety of stakeholders? Do you have good project management skills and the ability to share complex data and stories in way that is engaging, inspiring and which supports culture change?
Working in the Sustainability Office within the Organisational Support & Improvement team, the Sustainability Reporting & Communications Project Officer will work closely with a broad network of internal stakeholders, as well as external consultants, in delivering the Sustainability Reporting Project workstream.
You will also contribute to the development of CERN's Sustainability Strategy, with dedicated actions to raise awareness CERN-wide about sustainability, for example through targeted campaigns and communications that support cultural change around sustainability.
Through these activities, you will develop hands-on experience in sustainability strategy creation, implementation and reporting within a dynamic, high-profile, international scientific and technical environment.
Your responsibilities

• Support the delivery of CERN's 2025-2026 Sustainability Report (to be published in late 2027), from planning through to publication, and then assist preparations for the subsequent 2027-2028 reporting cycle.

• Write and edit social and governance content to a high standard for the Report, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and alignment with relevant GRI standards.

• Ensure adherence to the project plan, timeline, and documented approvals process.

• Produce engaging content for different channels and audiences, such as web, social media, short articles, and other formats that is consistent with strategy and reporting.

• Contribute to the development of an internal CERN e-learning module on sustainability.

• Support the planning and delivery of sustainability-related campaigns and events as needed.

• Track regulatory developments and evolving reporting standards (GRI, CSRD, ESRS) relevant to CERN's ESG framework.
More information here .
Your profile

• Experience of drafting sustainability or ESG reports in a corporate, NGO, research institution or public sector context, or in an advisory capacity.

• Experience managing complex, multi-workstream projects against firm deadlines with documented governance.

• Experience developing and implementing communications plans and outreach activities is desirable.

• Experience with digital content management systems and sustainability microsite or web content is desirable.

• Experience in a scientific, academic or intergovernmental setting is desirable.
Skills

• Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to produce clear, accurate, well-structured content for diverse audiences.

• Ability to work across functions, build trust, and obtain buy-in from varied stakeholders.

• French language proficiency is strongly desirable.

• Knowledge of GRI, CSRD/ESRS, or equivalent reporting frameworks and data visualisation or infographic design skills are desirable.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Sustainability, Communications (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 21.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-October-2026
Job reference: OSI-ICS-2026-125-GRAP
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark job: 5B0110 - Business Process Support Officer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

jobs.description:
Introduction:
 We invite you to take your career to an exciting new level by joining the team of operators who run the CERN accelerator complex from the CERN Control Centre ( CCC ). The Operations Group is responsible for the exploitation of the entire CERN accelerator complex and its technical infrastructure, including the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), running a rich proton, antiproton and heavy ion experimental programme. You will be at the heart of the preparation and delivery of particle beams to the different physics programs at CERN. When not operating these complex machines, you will contribute to the development of applications and advanced tools to support and improve operation.
 Functions:

• Take part in the 24/7 shift team which runs CERN's accelerator complex.

• Operate proton and/or ion accelerators (Linac3, Linac4, PSB, LEIR and/or PS) and the beam lines to the associated experimental facilities on a shift basis, ensuring the safe and timely execution of the physics schedule and obtaining the defined beam performance goals.

• Work closely with accelerator physicists to set up and optimise the accelerator operation and to design, document, commission and optimise various operational scenarios.

• Participate in the development of applications and advanced tools as part of a team or in collaboration with engineers or physicists within the OP group or within a specialised equipment group.

• Outside periods of accelerator operation, assist the technical infrastructure team with the operation of CERN's technical infrastructure or other CERN equipment groups, if required.

• Higher Technical or Administrative Diploma or equivalent in the field of Administration, Computer Engineering, Data Analysis (non-exhaustive) or a related field.
 Experience:

• Initial work experience in a technical or scientific environment.

• Experience in the field of physics, engineering or computing.

• Basic knowledge of software engineering in a modern development language environment.

• Familiarity with automation concepts and techniques, with an interest in improving operational efficiency and reliability.

• Drive to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and contribute to continuous operational improvements.

• Experience in the field of operating large facilities and their associated hardware (e.g. measurement devices, power converter techniques, vacuum equipment, PLCs, work in controlled radiation areas, etc.) would be an asset.
 Technical competencies:

• Operation of accelerators.

• Analysis and optimisation of accelerator performance.

• Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.

jobs.description:
Introduction
 Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) group is responsible for the design, the building, the operation and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy saving and recovery.
 You will join the PSM Section (EN-CV-PSM), which is in charge of the operation and maintenance of the cooling and ventilation systems of CERN’s accelerator complex and experimental areas. The activity includes the work site supervision for installation work and commissioning of new systems, upgrade of existing systems and consolidation of old systems.
 Are you a qualified technician, specialised in industrial cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems? Contribute your skill and experience to the operation and maintenance of complex cooling plants in a unique environment hosting some of the world’s most complex technical installations. Join CERN’s Cooling and Ventilation operation team. Take part!
 Functions

• Plan (by using the CMMS system), coordinate, supervise, check and perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities on cooling and ventilation systems.

• Perform operation activities to ensure appropriate running of the cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems.

• Ensure regular liaison with clients for all matters related to equipment under your responsibility.

• Propose and define the most appropriate solution to meet user needs in case of modification or renovation works.

• Technically coordinate contractors’ activities for maintenance and installation work in compliance with contractual clauses and technical standards.

• Contribute to projects from the design phase until test and commissioning of new cooling and ventilation systems.

• Ensure that the technical documentation is kept up-to-date and compliant with the quality standards.

• Ensure the respect of safety rules for all interventions.

• Follow up and regularly report on activities progress, schedule and costs.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Refrigeration and / or Electromechanics, or a related field.
 Having obtained the fluid handling permit, or equivalent is considered an advantage.
 Experience:

• Experience in maintenance, operation, and installation work on cooling, ventilation, and industrial systems.

• Experience in the technical coordination of external contractors.

• Experience in the use of CMMS tools.

• Experience in low-voltage electrical systems.

• Initial experience in compressed air systems.

• Experience in the operation and maintenance of refrigeration systems.

• Demonstrated experience in installation works.
 Technical competencies:

• Operation and maintenance of HVAC plants and networks.

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems.

• Design, construction, operation and maintenance of detector cooling systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Experience in work site supervision and as technical supervisor of contractors would be an advantage.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: being able to deal with ambiguous or unpredictable situations.

• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 18.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to asbestos.

• Exposure to lead.

• Radiation worker, category A.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: EN-CV-PSM-2026-122-LD
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione All'interno del reparto CERN Engineering (EN), il gruppo Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) è responsabile per la progettazione, l'edificio, il funzionamento e la manutenzione degli impianti di raffreddamento e ventilazione per grandi acceleratori di fisica dell'energia, esperimenti e impianti tecnici. Il gruppo EN-CV persegue sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione sostenibili che migliorano il risparmio energetico e il recupero. Vi unirete alla sezione PSM (EN-CV-PSM), che è responsabile del funzionamento e della manutenzione dei sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione delle aree complesse e sperimentali dell’acceleratore del CERN. L'attività comprende la supervisione del sito di lavoro per l'installazione e la messa in servizio di nuovi sistemi, l'aggiornamento dei sistemi esistenti e il consolidamento di vecchi sistemi. Sei un tecnico qualificato, specializzato in sistemi di raffreddamento industriale, ventilazione e refrigerazione? Contribuisci la tua abilità e la tua esperienza al funzionamento e alla manutenzione di complessi impianti di raffreddamento in un ambiente unico che ospita alcune delle installazioni tecniche più complesse del mondo. Unisciti al team operativo di raffreddamento e ventilazione del CERN. Prendi parte! Funzioni
• Pianificare (utilizzando il sistema CMMS), coordinare, supervisionare, controllare ed eseguire attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva sui sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione.
• Eseguire le attività di funzionamento per garantire un corretto funzionamento dei sistemi di raffreddamento, ventilazione e refrigerazione.
• Assicurare un collegamento regolare con i clienti per tutte le questioni relative alle attrezzature sotto la vostra responsabilità.
• Proporre e definire la soluzione più appropriata per soddisfare le esigenze degli utenti in caso di modifiche o lavori di ristrutturazione.
• Coordinare tecnicamente le attività degli appaltatori per lavori di manutenzione e installazione in conformità alle clausole contrattuali e agli standard tecnici.
• Contribuire a progetti dalla fase di progettazione fino alla prova e messa in servizio di nuovi sistemi di raffreddamento e ventilazione.
• Assicurarsi che la documentazione tecnica sia mantenuta aggiornata e conforme agli standard di qualità.
• Assicurare il rispetto delle norme di sicurezza per tutti gli interventi.
• Seguire e regolarmente riferire sui progressi, programmi e costi delle attività. Diploma tecnico superiore o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della refrigerazione e / o elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato. Avendo ottenuto il permesso di manipolazione del fluido, o equivalente è considerato un vantaggio. Esperienza:
• Esperienza in manutenzione, funzionamento e lavori di installazione su raffreddamento, ventilazione e sistemi industriali.
• Esperienza nel coordinamento tecnico degli imprenditori esterni.
• Esperienza nell'uso di strumenti CMMS.
• Esperienza nei sistemi elettrici a bassa tensione.
• Esperienza iniziale nei sistemi di aria compressa.
• Esperienza nel funzionamento e manutenzione dei sistemi di refrigerazione.
• Esperienza dimostrata nei lavori di installazione. Competenze tecniche:
• Funzionamento e manutenzione di impianti e reti HVAC.
• Funzionamento e manutenzione dei sistemi di raffreddamento dell'acqua.
• Progettazione, costruzione, funzionamento e manutenzione di sistemi di raffreddamento rilevatori.
• Funzionamento e manutenzione di circuiti elettrici e reti.
• L'esperienza nella supervisione del sito di lavoro e come supervisore tecnico degli appaltatori sarebbe un vantaggio. Competenze comportamentali:
• Ottenere risultati: fornire lavoro di alta qualità nel tempo e soddisfare le aspettative.
• Comunicare efficacemente: esprimere opinioni, idee e suggerimenti con convinzione e in modo logico/strutturato; mantenere al punto.
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: poter affrontare situazioni ambigue o imprevedibili.
• Risolvere i problemi: anticipare gli ostacoli; valutare soluzioni alternative per avere un piano di riduzione.
• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team. Capacità linguistiche: Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 18.08.2026 a 23:59 CEST . Condizioni di lavoro Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco Questa posizione comporta:
• Partecipazione ad un regolare servizio di stand-by, comprese le notti, la domenica e le festività ufficiali.
• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.
• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
• Lavoro a turni, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
• Esposizione all'amianto.
• Esposizione al piombo.
• Radiatori, categoria A.
• Esposizione al rischio di cadere da altezze durante l'assemblaggio di impalcatura e operazioni di smantellamento.
• Esposizione a campi elettromagnetici in determinate condizioni di esposizione.
• Lavoro a turni.
• In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale. Grado di lavoro: 3-4 Riferimento del lavoro: EN-CV-PSM-2026-122-LD Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria meccanica Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Tecnico meccanico Vantaggi globali
• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern

Einleitung Innerhalb der CERN Engineering Abteilung (EN) ist die Gruppe Kühlung und Lüftung (EN-CV) für die Planung, den Bau, den Betrieb und die Wartung der Kühl- und Lüftungsanlagen für große energiephysikalische Beschleuniger, Experimente und technische Anlagen verantwortlich. Die EN-CV-Gruppe verfolgt nachhaltige Kühl- und Lüftungssysteme, die die Energieeinsparung und -rückgewinnung verbessern. Sie treten der PSM-Sektion (EN-CV-PSM) bei, die für den Betrieb und die Wartung der Kühl- und Lüftungssysteme des CERN-Beschleunigerkomplexes und der Versuchsgebiete zuständig ist. Die Tätigkeit umfasst die Überwachung vor Ort für Installationsarbeiten und die Inbetriebnahme neuer Systeme, die Aktualisierung bestehender Systeme und die Konsolidierung alter Systeme. Sie sind qualifizierter Techniker, spezialisiert auf industrielle Kühl-, Lüftungs- und Kühlsysteme? Tragen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen zum Betrieb und zur Wartung komplexer Kühlanlagen in einer einzigartigen Umgebung mit einigen der komplexesten technischen Anlagen der Welt bei. Treten Sie dem Kühl- und Lüftungsteam des CERN bei. Nimm teil! Funktionen
• Planen Sie (unter Verwendung des CMMS-Systems), koordinieren, überwachen, überprüfen und führen Sie vorbeugende und korrigierende Wartungsarbeiten an Kühl- und Lüftungssystemen durch.
• Führen Sie Betriebsaktivitäten durch, um einen angemessenen Betrieb der Kühl-, Lüftungs- und Kühlsysteme zu gewährleisten.
• Stellen Sie eine regelmäßige Verbindung mit Kunden für alle Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Geräten unter Ihrer Verantwortung sicher.
• Vorschlagen und definieren Sie die am besten geeignete Lösung, um die Bedürfnisse des Benutzers im Falle von Änderungen oder Renovierungsarbeiten zu erfüllen.
• Technische Koordinierung der Tätigkeiten der Auftragnehmer für Wartungs- und Installationsarbeiten unter Einhaltung von Vertragsklauseln und technischen Normen.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Projekten von der Entwurfsphase bis zur Erprobung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Kühl- und Lüftungssysteme.
• Gewährleistung, dass die technische Dokumentation auf dem neuesten Stand ist und den Qualitätsstandards entspricht.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften für alle Eingriffe.
• Follow-up und berichten regelmäßig über Aktivitäten Fortschritt, Zeitplan und Kosten. Höheres technisches Diplom oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Kälte- und / oder Elektromechanik oder einem verwandten Gebiet. Die Erlangung der Fluidhandhabungserlaubnis oder eines gleichwertigen Dokuments wird als Vorteil angesehen. Erfahrung:
• Erfahrung in Wartungs-, Betriebs- und Installationsarbeiten an Kühl-, Lüftungs- und Industriesystemen.
• Erfahrung in der technischen Koordination von externen Auftragnehmern.
• Erfahrung in der Verwendung von CMMS-Tools.
• Erfahrung in Niederspannungsanlagen.
• Erste Erfahrungen mit Druckluftsystemen.
• Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Wartung von Kühlsystemen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Installationsarbeiten. Technische Kompetenzen:
• Betrieb und Wartung von HLK-Anlagen und -Netzen.
• Betrieb und Wartung von Kühlwassersystemen.
• Entwurf, Bau, Betrieb und Wartung von Detektorkühlsystemen.
• Betrieb und Wartung von Stromkreisen und Netzen.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeitsplatzüberwachung und als technischer Betreuer von Auftragnehmern wäre von Vorteil. Verhaltenskompetenzen:
• Ergebnisse erzielen: qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit pünktlich liefern und Erwartungen erfüllen.
• Effektiv kommunizieren: Meinungen, Ideen und Vorschläge mit Überzeugung und in einer logischen / strukturierten Weise ausdrücken; auf den Punkt bringen.

Présentation Au sein du département d'ingénierie du CERN (EN), le groupe Refroidissement et ventilation (EN-CV) est responsable de la conception, du bâtiment, de l'exploitation et de l'entretien des installations de refroidissement et de ventilation pour les grands accélérateurs de physique de l'énergie, les expériences et les installations techniques. Le groupe EN-CV poursuit des systèmes de refroidissement et de ventilation durables qui améliorent les économies d'énergie et la récupération. Contribuez à l'exploitation et à l'entretien d'installations de refroidissement complexes dans un environnement unique accueillant certaines des installations techniques les plus complexes du monde. • Proposer et définir la solution la plus appropriée pour répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs en cas de travaux de modification ou de rénovation.

• Contribuer aux projets depuis la phase de conception jusqu'à l'essai et la mise en service de nouveaux systèmes de refroidissement et de ventilation.
• Veiller à ce que la documentation technique soit tenue à jour et conforme aux normes de qualité.

jobs.title: ATLAS Detector Installation Technician (EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE)
jobs.description:
The EP-ATL-PO section plays a key role in the upgrade and maintenance of the ATLAS detector at the LHC. As a Junior Mechanical Technician, you will support experienced colleagues in mechanical installation and integration activities on the detector and its infrastructure during Long Shutdown 3 (LS3), while gaining hands-on experience in a cutting-edge experimental physics environment.
 Your responsibilities:

• Participate in large-scale ATLAS detector movements in the experimental cavern and in the installation of access platforms.

• Support sub-detector installation activities, including handling, transport, and positioning using appropriate lifting and alignment techniques.

• Prepare and set up work areas and tooling, and provide logistical support for detector interventions.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, perform basic dimensional checks, and report progress to supervising engineers.

• When required, manufacture parts and tooling using conventional machining techniques, such as drilling, milling, and turning.
 Your profile:

• Initial hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, fitting, or maintenance.

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and 2D/3D CAD models.

• Initial experience with conventional machining techniques and workshop practices.

• Basic metrology skills, including the use of calipers, gauges, and dimensional inspection tools.

• Awareness of occupational health and safety principles in workshop and industrial environments.
 Skills:

• Follow technical procedures, assembly instructions, and work specifications.

• Use of standard hand and power tools for mechanical operations.

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in an international and multidisciplinary environment.

• Rigorous, detail-oriented, and safety-conscious approach to work.

• Accurately document completed work and maintain high quality standards while following technical procedures and safety requirements.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date:  23.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.
 Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job reference: EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. descriptionByLocale.it:
La sezione EP-ATL-PO svolge un ruolo chiave nell'aggiornamento e nella manutenzione del rilevatore ATLAS presso la LHC. Come Tecnico Meccanico Junior, supporterai colleghi esperti nelle attività di installazione e integrazione meccanica del rivelatore e della sua infrastruttura durante il Long Shutdown 3 (LS3), acquisendo al contempo esperienza pratica in un ambiente fisico sperimentale all'avanguardia. Le tue responsabilità:
• Partecipa a movimenti di rilevatori ATLAS su larga scala nella caverna sperimentale e nell'installazione di piattaforme di accesso.
• Supporta attività di installazione sub-detector, tra cui movimentazione, trasporto e posizionamento utilizzando adeguate tecniche di sollevamento e allineamento.
• Preparare e configurare aree di lavoro e utensili, e fornire supporto logistico per gli interventi dei rivelatori.
• Leggere e interpretare i disegni meccanici, eseguire controlli dimensionali di base, e segnalare i progressi per supervisionare gli ingegneri.
• Quando necessario, fabbricare parti e utensili utilizzando tecniche di lavorazione convenzionali, come la perforazione, la fresatura e la tornitura. Il tuo profilo:
• Esperienza pratica iniziale nel montaggio meccanico, montaggio o manutenzione.
• Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni meccanici, progetti e modelli CAD 2D/3D.
• Esperienza iniziale con tecniche di lavorazione convenzionali e pratiche di officina.
• Capacità di metrologia di base, tra cui l'uso di calibri, manometri e strumenti di ispezione dimensionale.
• Consapevolezza dei principi di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro in officina e ambienti industriali. Competenze:
• Seguire procedure tecniche, istruzioni di montaggio e specifiche di lavoro.
• Utilizzo di utensili manuali e di potenza standard per operazioni meccaniche.
• Forte lavoro di squadra e capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collaborare in un ambiente internazionale e multidisciplinare.
• Un approccio rigoroso, orientato ai dettagli e sicuro al lavoro.
• Documentare accuratamente il lavoro completato e mantenere standard di alta qualità, seguendo le procedure tecniche e i requisiti di sicurezza.
• Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con l'impegno di imparare le basi dell'altra lingua. Criteri di ammissibilità:
• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .
• Con la scadenza della domanda, hai un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o equivalente (o un campo correlato) e la tua più alta qualifica educativa è un diploma di istruzione secondaria generale.
• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.
• I candidati con una laurea, Master o dottorato di ricerca non sono ammissibili. Data di chiusura del lavoro: 23.07.2026 alle 23:59 CEST. Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite Data di inizio obiettivo: 01-Novembre-2026 Questa posizione comporta:
• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.
• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
• Esposizione al rischio di cadere da altezze durante l'assemblaggio di impalcatura e operazioni di smantellamento. In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale. Riferimento del lavoro: EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria meccanica Benchmark job: 300090 - Tecnico meccanico Vantaggi globali
• Sospensione mensile di 4687 franchi svizzeri al mese (tassa libera).
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.
• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare.
